0022600218.text: Cleveland (5-5, 4-2 at home, 1-3 on the road) is seventh in the East and second in the Central, 1.5 games back, after a loss in its most recent game. New York (5-4 and riding a three-game winning streak) sits fifth in the East and third in the Atlantic, three games back, and the Cavaliers trail this season's series 0-1 after a 109-97 loss in Cleveland on November 7. Jaylon Tyson (ankle sprain) and Sam Merrill (elbow) are both out for Cleveland, and the Cavaliers lost 1-2 to New York in 2025-26 and 0-4 in the 2025-26 playoffs.
